messages:
mk_customer: hey team, we noticed our org dashboard shows 500 trial credits (expires in 10d) but all our service keys are being billed. console shows balance, api usage shows charges. can someone check?

lina_support: sorry you're hitting this — can you paste the org id and one example service key? we'll triage.

mk_customer: org: org_0a9d5, example key: sk-prod-9x7a. here's a minimal call that shows a charge: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/engines/text/generate \u002dH "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-9x7a" \u002dH "Content-Type: application/json" \u002d-d '{"input":"hello","max_tokens":5}'
```
response headers show x-rl-cost: 0.0045 and our dashboard still shows credit balance, but billing API /usage returns non-zero.

ramon_billing: pinging ledger. can you give me the promo code or grant id? sometimes org grants are created with allocation_scope=org and need project allocation.

mk_customer: grant id g-2026trial-57. promo code field blank, created via console free-trial flow.

eli_engineer: quick check — can you run the metering lookup for the key? run: 
```sql
SELECT * FROM metering.keys WHERE service_key='sk-prod-9x7a';
```
we want to see billing_project_id and org_id mapping.

marta_ops: i pulled the key record: org_id=org_0a9d5 billing_project_id=NULL created_at=2026-03-01. looks like older service-key flow that doesn't automatically bind to project.

lina_support: aha that matches a known edge case: org-level credit exists but metering expects a project-level allocation for service keys without billing_project_id. ask billing if auto-allocation ran.

ramon_billing: looking at grant g-2026trial-57 — allocation_scope=org, status=active, eligible=true. our allocation job should apply credits to projects, but I see no allocation event for org_0a9d5 in the job logs (resync missed).

billing-bot: [ledger-sync] resync job started for org_0a9d5 by mara_ops at 2026-03-05T12:02:13Z

eli_engineer: possible root cause: recent change to project-allocation pipeline skipped keys with NULL billing_project_id. We pushed a change last week that tightened validation.

marta_ops: can we do a manual workaround for customer while we fix pipeline? i can run a one-off allocation to attach credits to a temp project and update the key.

lina_support: yes pls. mk_customer: are you ok if we create a temporary billing project and move credits there so your service keys use them? minimal downtime.

mk_customer: yes please — thanks. totally fine.

ramon_billing: manual allocation performed: created project proj-alloc-2026-03 for org_0a9d5, attached 500 trial credits. allocation event id alloc_8943.

billing-bot: [ledger-update] allocation alloc_8943 applied, credits now visible on project proj-alloc-2026-03

eli_engineer: i updated metering.key for sk-prod-9x7a -> billing_project_id=proj-alloc-2026-03. note: if you have multiple keys i'll script this.

lina_support: mk_customer can you retry the call and paste headers?

mk_customer: retrying... 
```bash
curl -I -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/engines/text/generate \u002dH "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-9x7a" \u002dH "Content-Type: application/json" \u002d-d '{"input":"hi"}'
```
headers returned: x-rl-credit-applied: true, x-rl-cost: 0.0000, x-rl-balance-org: 500

mk_customer: verified — no billing charge now. thanks all.

ramon_billing: root cause: allocation pipeline regression where keys without billing_project_id were skipped. created ticket BILL-3721 to revert validation and add e2e test.

eli_engineer: i'll add a unit test to ensure allocation runs for null billing_project_id and schedule hotfix for pipeline.

marta_ops: scheduled manual backfill for other affected orgs; ETA 2 hours for first pass.

lina_support: i'll follow up with mk_customer in 24h to confirm no other issues. closing loop here. :thumbsup:

mk_customer: huge thanks — appreciate the quick help! :rocket:
